violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less (26 TAC §746.4805(b))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less
violation_type.typical_finding: The use zone in front of the slide did not extend at least six feet.

finding_variants.text: The use zone in front of the slide did not extend at least six feet.
The use zones for the slide is less than six feet required.
The use zone in front of the exit of one slide did not extend six feet.

The operation has two playground structures that were not in compliance with the fall zones.  The slides must have an area of six feet in front or beside that does not prevent them from hitting another structure or concrete if a child were to fall.
The use zone for 3 slides did not extend 6 feet from the exit of the slide and overlapped into other use zone space.
One slide had 4 feet 4 inches clearance at the bottom of the slide.
